svg.title: BootWire: what each layer adds
svg.text: One WRITE request (SEQ 0x05, 4 bytes C0 DB 11 22 to 0x08008000) on its way down the host stack. The target runs the same steps upward.

svg.text: data bits of 0xC0, least significant bit first
Each byte: start bit, 8 data bits, stop bit
UART RX interrupt → SLIP RX state machine (removes END and escapes) → CRC-16 check → reply cache and dispatcher → flash driver.
The response travels back the same way, with STATUS after CMD | 0x80.
